Stage 5 Science Assessment,SC5-WS-01 Observing,Selects and uses appropriate tools and techniques to gather valid and reliable data.,5,No Evidence / Not Submitted,"No evidence has been provided for this criterion, or the relevant section was not submitted.",0,Limited,"Minimal understanding of observations/measurement
does not recognise basic tool purposes.",1,Working Towards Standard,"Shows partial understanding of observation quality

may state that tools are needed but cannot explain accuracy/precision or choose the best tool.",2,At Standard,"Demonstrates sound understanding that accurate observations require relevant tools, appropriate units, and repeated measures

distinguishes observation vs inference at a basic level.",3,Above Standard,"Shows strong, connected understanding of how tool selection, resolution, and correct technique affect measurement accuracy and reliability

explains why specific tools fit the task.",4,Well Above Standard,"Demonstrates comprehensive, integrated understanding of measurement accuracy, precision, resolution, uncertainty, and error (systematic vs random).

Optimises observation strategies to improve validity and reliability (e.g., calibration, repeats, averaging, inter‑rater checks).",5,Beyond Stage,"Demonstrates advanced metrological reasoning that integrates uncertainty analysis, propagation of error, instrument limitations and data‑quality modelling. Justifies measurement strategy using quantitative reasoning (e.g., uncertainty budgets, resolution–range trade‑offs) and adapts approach for high‑precision or real‑world constraints.",5
